feeds.title: UrbanGeekz
feeds.description: A groundbreaking African American digital news site focused on Technology, Business, and Science from a Black News and Latino perspective. UrbanGeekz is the first to market a multicultural digital news platform focused on technology, business, science, and startups. Our mission is to make technology 'cool' and accessible for women and underrepresented groups.

feeds.title: Obsidi Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest tips and information on Black professionals in tech through these engaging blogs on Obsidi. Obsidi is a multi-sided networking platform for Black professionals to build relationships, leverage job opportunities and connect with Black executives.

feeds.title: POCIT
feeds.description: POCIT is the world's leading platform for people of color in tech to share, grow, and get hired. Telling the stories and thoughts of people of color in tech.

feeds.title: Blacks In Technology
feeds.description: Posts on social Networking community and Blacks In Tech related fields. Blacks In Technology Foundation is the official 501(c)(3) non-profit entity of Blacks in Technology, LLC. A global platform for Black people in technology. BIT serves members through community, media and mentorship. We provide resources, guidance and challenge members to establish new standards of innovation.

feeds.title: Adora Hack
feeds.description: Adora Hack contains articles on Technology and Software Development. I am Nenne Adaora (Adora) Nwodo, a Software Engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria.

feeds.title: Black Tech Talent Blog
feeds.description: Black Tech Talent aims to increase the talent pool of Black technologists by curating job opportunities, resources and culturally specific content! Know more about job opportunities in the industry, tips to get employed in your desired field and more1

feeds.title: rss2
feeds.description: Black Women Talk Tech is an organization that aims to identify, support and encourage black women to build the next billion-dollar business. They are the largest collective of Black women tech founders with a unique understanding of the challenges black women face and the advantages they bring in the industry. The organization is building community and profitable, scalable businesses for self-identified Black women in tech. Thier press blog shares information about the latest updates of the organization and some informative articles for their readers.

feeds.title: BrothaTech Blog
feeds.description: I'm an IT professional, consultant, and personal technology specialist in Atlanta, GA with over 20 years of experience in helping businesses large and small, leverage technology for growth. My mission is to teach entrepreneurs and individuals alike, how to benefit from technology and use it to simplify their lives. I write on multiple topics including cloud security, cloud, Apple products and more!
